description.zh: IP段列表。IP与IP之间用中横线“-”间隔； 每行一个IP段，最少1行最多50行；只有一个IP填写IP1-IP1，不同IP段不能交叉。
description.en: The CIDR blocks. Separate IP addresses with a hyphen (-). Enter a CIDR block in each row. You can enter 1 to 50 CIDR blocks at a time. If a CIDR block contains only one IP address, enter the IP address in the format of IP1-IP1. Different CIDR blocks cannot be overlapped.

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

description.zh: 自定义线路唯一ID。可通过调用[DescribeCustomLines](~~2355671~~)获取。
description.en: The unique ID of the custom line. You can call the [DescribeCustomLines](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describecustomlines?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) operation to obtain the unique ID.

description.zh: 自定义线路名称，长度限制为1-20个字符，允许包含中文、字母、数字、'-'、'_'这些字符。
description.en: The name of the custom line. The name must be 1 to 20 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-custom-line --lang en --line-name '望京线路' --line-id 10000000 --ip-segment StartIp=1.1.XX.XX EndIp=2.2.XX.XX --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns UpdateCustomLine --region cn-hangzhou --IpSegment.1.EndIp '2.2.XX.XX' --LineId 10000000 --IpSegment.1.StartIp '1.1.XX.XX' --Lang en --LineName '望京线路'
